title: Hot and Cold Water Pipes Sizing
description: Recommended dimensions for hot and cold water pipes. Determine the maximum numbers of draw offs served by a pipe based on nominal bore and pipe type.

components.content:
### Notes
* Basins, sinks, showers and similar are regarded as 1 draw off
* Baths and similar are regarded as 2 draw offs

### How to Use
1. Identify the number of draw offs required
2. Select the nominal bore that accommodates that number
3. Choose the appropriate pipe type (Steel or Copper) and head pressure range
4. Reference the recommended pipe dimensions from the table
